title: Acyclicity on the closed projective line
statement:
In the setup of [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselian-setup]: let $(A,\mathfrak m)$ be a strictly henselian local ring with residue field $\kappa=A/\mathfrak m$, $S=\operatorname{Spec}A$, $s=\operatorname{Spec}\kappa$, $X=\mathbf P^1_S=\mathbf P(\{0,1\};S)$ [def-nagata-projective-space-base-change], $X_0=\mathbf P^1_s=X\times_Ss$ its closed fibre and $i:X_0\to X$ the closed immersion (the base change of $s\to S$). Let $r$ be a prime and $I$ an injective object of the category of sheaves of $\mathbf F_r$-modules on $X_{\Et}$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], and $I_0=i^{-1}I$ its inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Then

$$
 H^q(X_{0,\Et},I_0)=0\qquad(q>0),
$$

where $H^q$ is the etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] of the underlying abelian sheaf of $I_0$ (cohomology computed in abelian sheaves, as in the users and in the Lean statement).

(Remark. Stacks Lemma 0A5H assumes only that $A$ is henselian, and the proof below uses only that $(A,\mathfrak m)$ is a henselian pair; the hypothesis "strictly henselian" is kept because the setup [def-weil-pbc-strict-henselian-setup], the user [prop-weil-pbc-p1-strict-henselian-comparison] and the Lean declaration AlgebraicGeometry.Etale.subsingleton_H_projectiveLine_closedFibre_of_injective state it so. Stacks states the lemma for $\mathbf Z/\ell\mathbf Z$-modules, $\ell$ prime, which is the present $\mathbf F_r$.)

proof.text: For q>1 apply the general bound with n=1, the maximal ideal, and the projective space pullback square. The two standard affine charts cover; reindex the ULift cover by Equiv.ulift. Finite coefficients make the injective sheaf torsion.

For q=1 represent an arbitrary class as a finite sum from finite constant pushforwards. The new finite-pushforward image theorem kills each summand. The sum is zero, hence H¹ is subsingleton. These two cases cover all q>0.
